_comment: Every file carrying a PARKED promise whose re-review date has already passed, measured 2026-11-12 (DR-1444). DR-0075: a parked thing carries a re-review date and that date IS the promise it is revisited — but nothing ever checked whether the date had PASSED, only that it was shaped like one (system-flow-graph.mjs:205). Measured: 54 of 73 machine-readable dates were already past due, the oldest by 103 days. This baseline is the honest starting line so the gate can refuse NEW drift today rather than wait for a clean slate. Both ceilings are DOWN-ONLY, the same shape as the YAML line ceiling (DR-1342/DR-1343): re-freeze lower with `node scripts/re-review-ratchet-guard.mjs --generate` once dates are moved forward. A ninth file, or one more overdue date in any file already listed, fails the build. THE BLOCKERS ARE NOT COPIED HERE: each item carries its own in the data beside it (buildPath / purchasePath / neededSince / blocker / disabledWhy / why), and duplicating them into this file would create a second place to drift from. `blockersLiveIn` says which field to read.
